data: Same sealed TRAIN100 and four fixed DEV_REFERENCE_NOT_BC episodes; no original DEV80 or TEST
TRAIN: Existing fixed40 real phase/recovery probes x3 noises=120/method
DEV_reference: Four fixed layouts x5 real phase anchors x3 noises=60/method; not60 independent scenes
reuse: All40 sealed group0 TRAIN predictions per method; no repeated queries
mechanism_signal: Relative to A, >=0.20 envelope pass fraction gain OR >=0.50 reduction of P95 per-window peak acceleration excess ratio max(peak/0.25-1,0)
additional_motion_safeguard: Expert net displacement>=1mm: >=90% positive direction and median predicted/expert displacement ratio>=0.8
phase_error_safeguard: Every phase: mean XYZ regression<=0.5mm and P95 point XYZ regression<=1mm, frozen in original loss preregistration
NaN: Retained in full denominator as nonfinite rejected output
D_admission: Both TRAIN and DEV-reference must satisfy mechanism signal, finite outputs, motion and phase error safeguards; conservative operationalization frozen before any new DEV query
